notes: A character you walk out of a group chat with now actually remembers it when you carry on with them alone. The group's recent messages were already being handed to her, correctly dated and correctly placed in the running order — but they were quoted at the end of the system prompt, above the whole of the private chat's own history, so after reading them she read a hundred lines of last week's private conversation and picked up from last week. The dates were right and the memory was still lost to sheer recency. The other room now goes into the transcript itself, as a bracketed note at the point in the story where it happened: after the old private messages and right before the message being answered, which is where a reader's sense of what just happened actually lives. The closing note that already pins the length, the mode and the clock also now says, when the newest thing that happened to her was elsewhere, that that is where she is coming from and the earlier messages in this chat are older than it. The same splice works in the other direction — a character in a group chat carries her own private chat in at its place in time — and the privacy rules are unchanged: only her own private chat, never anyone else's, and never in front of the others.
